# Azure Functions - issues and retirement readiness

Fleet-wide view of Azure Function App problems using Azure Resource Graph, with
on-demand ARM runtime details. Includes dedicated tracking for the **Linux Consumption plan retirement
(30 September 2028)**.

parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| where properties.state =~ 'Enabled'
| project value = id, label = name, selected = true
| order by label asc
parameters.description: Subscriptions to scan for Function Apps.

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind contains 'functionapp'
| where kind !contains 'workflowapp'
| summarize Apps = count() by resourceGroup
| project value = resourceGroup, label = strcat(resourceGroup, ' (', Apps, ')'), selected = false
| order by label asc

parameters.name: FunctionApps
parameters.label: Function apps
parameters.query:

| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind contains 'functionapp'

| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| project value = tolower(id), label = name, selected = false
| order by label asc

## Azure Functions - issue overview

Findings are derived entirely from **Azure Resource Graph**, so this reflects
control-plane configuration across every selected subscription with no agent,
diagnostic setting, or Application Insights dependency.

Findings are review indicators, not a formal compliance verdict. Missing values do
not automatically become failures, and **No detected findings** does not mean every
security control has been assessed. HTTP/2 and client certificates are informational
settings, not mandatory requirements for every Function App.

See the **About the data** tab for exactly which properties Resource Graph does
and does not expose - some settings (TLS version, FTPS state, CORS) are *not*
retrievable through Resource Graph and are intentionally not shown here.

resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind contains 'functionapp'
| where kind !contains 'workflowapp'
| extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| extend _apps = dynamic([{FunctionApps}])
| where array_length(_apps) == 0 or set_has_element(_apps, '*') or set_has_element(_apps, tolower(id))
| extend planId    = tolower(tostring(properties.serverFarmId))
| extend tier      = tostring(properties.sku)
| extend isLinux   = tobool(properties.reserved)
| extend osType    = case(isLinux == true or kind contains 'linux', 'Linux', isLinux == false or kind contains 'windows', 'Windows', 'Unknown')
| extend state     = tostring(properties.state)
| extend enabledFlag = tobool(properties.enabled)
| extend httpsOnly = tobool(properties.httpsOnly)
| extend pna       = tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess)
| extend subnetId  = tostring(properties.virtualNetworkSubnetId)
| extend availability = tostring(properties.availabilityState)
| extend usage     = tostring(properties.usageState)
| extend identityType = tostring(identity.type)
| extend clientCert = tobool(properties.clientCertEnabled)
| extend clientCertMode = tostring(properties.clientCertMode)
| extend defaultHost = tostring(properties.defaultHostName)
| extend memQuota  = toint(properties.dailyMemoryTimeQuota)
| extend redundancy = tostring(properties.redundancyMode)
| extend lastModified = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedTimeUtc)
| extend alwaysOn  = tobool(properties.siteConfig.alwaysOn)
| extend http2     = tobool(properties.siteConfig.http20Enabled)
| extend flexRuntimeName = tostring(properties.functionAppConfig.runtime.name),
    flexRuntimeVersion = tostring(properties.functionAppConfig.runtime.version),
    linuxFx = tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion),
    windowsFx = tostring(properties.siteConfig.windowsFxVersion)
| extend RuntimeStack = case(
    isnotempty(flexRuntimeName), strcat(flexRuntimeName, iff(isempty(flexRuntimeVersion), '', strcat('|', flexRuntimeVersion))),
    isnotempty(linuxFx), linuxFx,
    windowsFx)
| extend RuntimeSource = case(
    isnotempty(flexRuntimeName), 'functionAppConfig.runtime',
    isnotempty(linuxFx), 'siteConfig.linuxFxVersion',
    isnotempty(windowsFx), 'siteConfig.windowsFxVersion',
    '')
| extend Language = case(
    isnotempty(flexRuntimeName), flexRuntimeName,
    RuntimeStack startswith 'DOCKER|', '',
    tostring(split(RuntimeStack, '|')[0])),
    LangVersion = case(
    isnotempty(flexRuntimeName), flexRuntimeVersion,
    RuntimeStack startswith 'DOCKER|', '',
    RuntimeStack contains '|', tostring(split(RuntimeStack, '|')[1]),
    '')
| extend scaleLimit = coalesce(toint(properties.functionAppConfig.scaleAndConcurrency.maximumInstanceCount),
    toint(properties.siteConfig.functionAppScaleLimit))
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms'
    | project planId = tolower(id),
              planName = name,
              planSkuName = tostring(sku.name),
              planSkuTier = tostring(sku.tier),
              planCapacity = toint(sku.capacity),
              planZoneRedundant = tobool(properties.zoneRedundant)
  ) on planId
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
| extend tier = coalesce(tier, planSkuTier)
| extend isConsumption = (tier =~ 'Dynamic'), isFlex = (tier =~ 'FlexConsumption'), isPremium = (tier =~ 'ElasticPremium')
| extend isServerless = (isConsumption or isFlex), isDedicated = (isnotempty(tier) and not(isConsumption or isFlex or isPremium))
| extend TierLabel = case(
      isConsumption, 'Consumption (Y1)', isFlex, 'Flex Consumption',
      isPremium, 'Premium (Elastic)', isempty(tier), 'Unknown', tier)
| extend isLinuxConsumption = (isConsumption and osType == 'Linux')
| extend SkuDisplay = strcat(coalesce(planSkuTier, tier), iff(isnotempty(planSkuName), strcat(' (', planSkuName, ')'), ''))
| extend IssueList = array_concat(
    iff(isLinuxConsumption == true,                     pack_array('Linux Consumption retiring 30 Sep 2028'), dynamic([])),
    iff(httpsOnly == false,                             pack_array('HTTPS-only disabled'), dynamic([])),
    iff((isnotempty(state) and state !~ 'Running') or enabledFlag == false, pack_array('Stopped or disabled'), dynamic([])),
    iff(isempty(identityType) or identityType =~ 'None', pack_array('No managed identity'), dynamic([])),
    iff(isnotempty(availability) and availability !~ 'Normal', pack_array(strcat('Availability: ', availability)), dynamic([])),
    iff(isnotempty(usage) and usage !~ 'Normal',         pack_array(strcat('Usage state: ', usage)), dynamic([])),
    iff(alwaysOn == false and isDedicated,              pack_array('Always On disabled'), dynamic([])),
    iff(pna =~ 'Enabled',                              pack_array('Public network access enabled - review ingress restrictions'), dynamic([])),
    iff(memQuota > 0,                                  pack_array('Daily memory quota cap set'), dynamic([]))
  )
| extend IssueCount = array_length(IssueList)
| extend Issues     = strcat_array(IssueList, ' | ')
| extend Severity = case(
      isLinuxConsumption == true and IssueCount >= 4, 'Critical',
      isLinuxConsumption == true,                     'High',
      IssueCount >= 5,                                'High',
      IssueCount >= 2,                                'Medium',
      IssueCount >= 1,                                'Low',
                                                      'No detected findings')
| extend SeverityRank = case(Severity == 'Critical', 0, Severity == 'High', 1, Severity == 'Medium', 2, Severity == 'Low', 3, 4)
| summarize
    TotalApps    = count(),
    LinuxCons    = countif(isLinuxConsumption == true),
    AtRisk       = countif(IssueCount > 0),
    CriticalHigh = countif(Severity in ('Critical','High')),
    Stopped      = countif((isnotempty(state) and state !~ 'Running') or enabledFlag == false),
    NoIdentity   = countif(isempty(identityType) or identityType =~ 'None'),
    NoHttps      = countif(httpsOnly == false)
| extend Tiles = pack_array(
    pack('Metric', 'Function apps',            'Value', TotalApps,    'Rank', 1),
    pack('Metric', 'Linux Consumption (retiring)', 'Value', LinuxCons, 'Rank', 2),
    pack('Metric', 'Apps with findings',       'Value', AtRisk,       'Rank', 3),
    pack('Metric', 'Critical or high',         'Value', CriticalHigh, 'Rank', 4),
    pack('Metric', 'Stopped or disabled',      'Value', Stopped,      'Rank', 5),
    pack('Metric', 'No managed identity',      'Value', NoIdentity,   'Rank', 6),
    pack('Metric', 'HTTPS-only disabled',      'Value', NoHttps,      'Rank', 7))
| mv-expand Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tiles.Metric), Value = toint(Tiles.Value), Rank = toint(Tiles.Rank)
| order by Rank asc

## Retirement: Linux Consumption plan for Azure Functions

The Linux Consumption hosting plan **retires on 30 September 2028**. Affected apps
must move to the **Flex Consumption** plan, which adds faster scaling, virtual
network integration, cold-start mitigation and concurrency control.

**Earlier hard deadline:** function apps still on the end-of-life **v3 runtime**
on Linux Consumption **stop running after 30 September 2026**.

**How apps are identified here** - exactly the criteria from the retirement notice
(*App Service plans with Pricing Tier: Dynamic (Y1: 0) and Operating System: Linux*),
evaluated in Resource Graph as `properties.sku == 'Dynamic'` and
`properties.reserved == true`.

Windows Consumption is **not** retiring, but Flex Consumption is Linux-only, so
Windows apps are listed separately as advisory.

Guidance: [Migrate Consumption to Flex Consumption](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/migration/migrate-plan-consumption-to-flex) |
[Retirement notice](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates/?id=499451)

blank or are marked **Not reported**, rather than being assumed disabled or zero.
**Plan capacity** is configured App Service plan capacity, not a count of running
Function workers. **Scale limit** is a configured ceiling; zero means the platform
default, not zero allowed instances. Elastic Premium manages readiness itself, so
the dedicated-plan Always On requirement does not apply.

health-check path) are deliberately **omitted**. They need direct ARM or Azure Policy
evidence and are not assessed by these fleet grids. No collector is required to use
this workbook.

    isnotempty(flexRuntimeName), strcat(flexRuntimeName, iff(isempty(flexRuntimeVersion), '', strcat('|', flexRuntimeVersion))),
    isnotempty(linuxFx), linuxFx,
    windowsFx)
| extend RuntimeSource = case(
    isnotempty(flexRuntimeName), 'functionAppConfig.runtime',
    isnotempty(linuxFx), 'siteConfig.linuxFxVersion',
    isnotempty(windowsFx), 'siteConfig.windowsFxVersion',
    '')
| extend Language = case(
    isnotempty(flexRuntimeName), flexRuntimeName,
    RuntimeStack startswith 'DOCKER|', '',
    tostring(split(RuntimeStack, '|')[0])),
    LangVersion = case(
    isnotempty(flexRuntimeName), flexRuntimeVersion,
    RuntimeStack startswith 'DOCKER|', '',
    RuntimeStack contains '|', tostring(split(RuntimeStack, '|')[1]),
    '')
| extend scaleLimit = coalesce(toint(properties.functionAppConfig.scaleAndConcurrency.maximumInstanceCount),
    toint(properties.siteConfig.functionAppScaleLimit))
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms'
    | project planId = tolower(id),
              planName = name,
              planSkuName = tostring(sku.name),
              planSkuTier = tostring(sku.tier),
              planCapacity = toint(sku.capacity),
              planZoneRedundant = tobool(properties.zoneRedundant)
  ) on planId
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
| extend tier = coalesce(tier, planSkuTier)
| extend isConsumption = (tier =~ 'Dynamic'), isFlex = (tier =~ 'FlexConsumption'), isPremium = (tier =~ 'ElasticPremium')
| extend isServerless = (isConsumption or isFlex), isDedicated = (isnotempty(tier) and not(isConsumption or isFlex or isPremium))
| extend TierLabel = case(
      isConsumption, 'Consumption (Y1)', isFlex, 'Flex Consumption',
      isPremium, 'Premium (Elastic)', isempty(tier), 'Unknown', tier)
| extend isLinuxConsumption = (isConsumption and osType == 'Linux')
| extend SkuDisplay = strcat(coalesce(planSkuTier, tier), iff(isnotempty(planSkuName), strcat(' (', planSkuName, ')'), ''))
| where id =~ '{HealthApp}'
| summarize Apps = make_list(pack('id', id, 'name', name, 'subscription', Subscription, 'subscriptionId', subscriptionId,
    'resourceGroup', resourceGroup, 'os', osType, 'isFlex', isFlex, 'stack', RuntimeStack), 2)
| extend App = iff(array_length(Apps) == 1, Apps[0], dynamic({}))
| project value = tostring(pack('status', iff(array_length(Apps) == 1, 'ready', 'Select one Function App within the current filters.'),
    'app', App)), selected = true

## About the data in this workbook

Fleet findings come from **Azure Resource Graph** (`queryType: 1`). **Runtime details**
and the selected-app Resource Health view use read-only ARM calls for one app. No Log
Analytics workspace, diagnostic setting or Application Insights resource is
required, so the workbook returns results immediately in any subscription.

### Verified Resource Graph behaviour

These findings were measured against live Function App resources, not assumed
from ARM template documentation:

| Source | Availability in Resource Graph |
| --- | --- |
| `microsoft.web/sites` top-level `properties` | Richly populated - the basis of this workbook |
| `properties.siteConfig.alwaysOn`, `.http20Enabled`, `.functionAppScaleLimit` | Populated in tested fixtures |
| Runtime stack | Flex uses `functionAppConfig.runtime`; Linux/Windows stack field coverage varies. Use Runtime details when absent. |
| `properties.siteConfig.minTlsVersion`, `.ftpsState`, `.cors`, `.healthCheckPath`, `.remoteDebuggingEnabled`, `.ipSecurityRestrictions` | Keys existed but values were null in the surveyed resources |
| `microsoft.web/sites/config` | **Not indexed at all** (zero rows) |
| `microsoft.insights/diagnosticsettings` | **Not indexed at all** (zero rows) |

Because detailed site configuration is not reliably populated in Resource Graph, this
workbook does **not** display TLS, FTPS, CORS, IP-restriction, remote-debugging or
health-check columns. Showing them would produce a column reading "Unknown" for
every app. These controls need direct ARM or Azure Policy evidence; they are not
assessed by the fleet grids. The runtime and health drill-downs need no collector.

### How severity is calculated

Linux Consumption retirement exposure dominates, because it is a hard deadline
rather than a tunable setting:

| Severity | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| Critical | On Linux Consumption **and** 3 or more other findings |
| High | On Linux Consumption, or 5+ findings |
| Medium | 2-4 findings |
| Low | 1 finding |
| No detected findings | No findings from the assessed fields; not a compliance or health certification |

### Scope

Azure Functions only. Logic Apps (Standard) carry `kind = 'functionapp,workflowapp'`
and are explicitly excluded, as are plain App Service web apps.

### Key retirement dates

| Date | Event |
| --- | --- |
| 30 September 2026 | Apps on the end-of-life **v3 runtime** on Linux Consumption stop running |
| 30 September 2028 | **Linux Consumption plan retires** |

References:
[Retirement notice](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates/?id=499451) |
[Consumption plan (legacy)](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/consumption-plan) |
[Flex Consumption plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/flex-consumption-plan) |
[Migration guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/migration/migrate-plan-consumption-to-flex)
